covered_cases: identity, gzip, x-gzip, zlib deflate and zstd decode to exact source bytes
comma-separated encodings decode in reverse application order
every incremental and intermediate expansion uses the same request budget
decoded hard limits and memory pressure retain distinct status and retry semantics
truncated or invalid compressed streams fail closed
unsupported encodings and errors do not include request content
side_effects: none beyond the caller-owned request budget reservation
